blurb: Serving Lower East Side Manhattan, NY, Chinatown and East Village, NY for more than a decade, Coral Essex Spa specializes in massage therapy, including full-body, back, and foot massages. Our serene, luxurious massage spa employs certified massage therapists to help our clients with their aches, pains, and stress. We’re conveniently located a block away from the Delancey Street subway station on the Lower East Side.
